video_summary.overall_goal: Navigate through audiobook playback and access app settings
video_summary.description: User opens Home Radio Audio Player app showing Alice's Adventures in Wonderland audiobook. Taps play button to start playback. Views playback controls and navigation. Switches to Hamlet audiobook. Then taps settings gear icon and navigates through Settings menu, viewing Lockdown settings screen before returning to main playback.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: App displays 'Alice's Adventures in Wonderland' title with a large green play button in the center. Header shows time (1:05) and status icons.
steps.navigation_change: Stays on same screen, playback controls become visible
steps.visual_feedback: Play button state changes, playback controls appear with volume and skip buttons

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Playback controls visible: volume icons on left (muted/unmuted states), blue skip/forward buttons (prev, rewind 30s, forward 10s, next). Red circular player button in center with play/pause control.
steps.system_response: Audiobook continues playing, user views controls
steps.visual_feedback: Controls displayed, progress bar shows playback position
steps.intent_task: View available playback controls for audio navigation

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Screen transitions to display 'Hamlet' title with green play button. Same layout as step 1 but with different audiobook.
visible_ui_elements: Status bar with time and indicators
steps.system_response: Screen updates to show Hamlet audiobook details
steps.navigation_change: Audiobook view changed from Alice's Adventures to Hamlet
steps.visual_feedback: New audiobook title displayed, fresh play button shown
steps.intent_task: View different audiobook in the collection

steps.what_screen_is_visible: User taps settings gear icon. Settings menu appears with list of options: Player controls, Playback settings, Audiobooks and podcasts, Network and downloads, Text-to-speech, Color scheme, Lockdown settings, About the app, Rate the application.
steps.visual_feedback: Settings menu list displayed with all available options
steps.intent_task: Access app settings and configuration options

steps.what_screen_is_visible: User navigates to Lockdown settings submenu. Screen shows 'Lockdown settings' header with description 'Lock down the app to make a device only for playing audiobooks.' Multiple toggle options visible: Application lockdown (kiosk mode) - Disabled, Orientation - Auto, Screen margins, Show battery indicator - enabled (green toggle), Hide settings button - disabled (grey toggle), and Advanced section with 'Become a Home screen app' option.
visible_ui_elements: Become a Home screen app option
steps.visual_feedback: Settings options and toggle states displayed
steps.intent_task: View and potentially modify lockdown/kiosk mode settings

steps.what_screen_is_visible: User presses back arrow to return from Lockdown settings. Screen shows Settings menu again, but with Hamlet audiobook title visible in background (semi-transparent overlay). Then screen transitions back to Hamlet playback view with Settings menu still partially visible, showing 'Hamlet' title and green play button with settings options overlay.
steps.system_response: Navigation back to Settings menu, then back to main Hamlet screen
steps.navigation_change: Return from Lockdown settings to Settings menu to main playback screen
steps.visual_feedback: Screen transitions back, Settings overlay fades
steps.intent_task: Return from settings to main audiobook playback

overall_flow: Tap play button to initiate playback
View playback controls and listen to audio
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1: The app opens displaying 'Alice's Adventures in Wonderland' audiobook with a play button. User taps the play button to start playback.
Step 2: Playback controls become visible, showing volume, skip, rewind, and forward buttons. User waits and observes the controls during playback.
Step 3: The screen transitions to show 'Hamlet' audiobook instead of Alice's Adventures.
Step 4: User taps the settings gear icon in the top-right corner, opening the Settings menu with various options.
Step 5: User navigates to and views the 'Lockdown settings' submenu, which shows options for restricting app functionality.
Step 6: User presses the back arrow to return from Lockdown settings and navigate back to the main Hamlet playback screen.
